SetShd.description: Specifies the shading which is applied to the extents of the current table.

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the current table. If not passed, the shading will be cleared.
params.name: fill

SetTableBorderAll.description: Specifies a border which will be displayed on all table cell borders.

params.description: The border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current border.
params.name: size

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the current border.
params.name: fill

SetTableBorderAll.signature: SetTableBorderAll(type: BorderType, size: mm, fill: ApiFill): boolean

SetTableBorderInsideH.description:
Specifies the border which will be displayed on all horizontal table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge
